title: The Stick Figures Woke Up as Their World Tore Apart
altTitles: Born in the Margin | Stick Figure Mini-Movie
Four Doodles vs. a Falling World
description: Four doodles wake up in the margin of a sketchbook just as their world starts tearing apart. #stickfigure #animation #INKLIGHT
topic: L01 pilot (F3 indie pilot + F2 gauntlet): the margin wakes, the page tears, the Nib shard, Smudge watches

sections.label: S1 Cold open: the fall
sections.videoPrompt: Cinematic 3D animated film. The characters are stylized stick figures: glossy matte-black ink bodies with uniform thin cylindrical limbs, perfectly round glossy black heads with no facial features except two small glowing oval eyes, and a thin emissive rim light in each character's signature color. They are set inside a hyper-detailed, physically lit 3D environment with volumetric light shafts, atmospheric haze, real materials, shallow depth of field and film-grade color grading. <<<image_1>>> BOLT: an average-height black ink stick figure with a round glossy head, electric cyan (#22D3EE) glowing eyes and rim light, a long flowing cyan scarf that trails light when moving. Bolt free-falls head-first past towering cliffs made of torn, curling sheets of giant paper, his cyan scarf streaming upward like a comet tail, paper fragments and dust tumbling around him, then slams onto a narrow rock ledge and his ink splashes outward into glowing cyan sparks. Camera tracks the fall from above, rolls with him, and ends low-angle at the ledge. Warm gold sunlight from above, dust haze. Avoid: text, letters, numbers, logos, mouths, noses, teeth, human faces, skin, hair, clothing beyond the listed accessories, extra limbs, fingers except three rounded nubs in close-ups, blood, gore, flat or empty backgrounds. genre=action pacing=chaotic camera_model=modern camera_lens=anamorphic color_palette=highway-standoff

sections.label: S2 The margin wakes

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Nobody drew them on purpose. They were doodles. Warm-ups. Four figures of ink, left in the margin of a sketchbook called the First Draft.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: And tonight, they opened their eyes.

qc: L01: Drift — 4-cast CS4 shots (S2, S4, S5, S10): Pip is half Bolt's height; Brick's limbs 3× thick; Nova's topknot one curved line; Bolt the only scarf. Limbs — S5 plank-hopping and S8 melee: count limbs at every hit; grey goons merging into heroes = reject. Faces — S7 underlight on heads (macro), S10 firelight close shots: eyes only. Style — S4 sky tear stays paper-real (not a flat 2D texture); S11 night must not crush to black (rims visible). Seams — S5 at 30s/60s: direction stays L→R and Nova's staff stays in her right hand; S2 at 30s: Bolt's position after the hop; S8 at 30s: the bind held across the seam. Text — paper cliffs spawn fake handwriting; any legible glyphs = mask or re-roll ('blank paper, pencil texture only'). CS4 chaining (lessons Q7): check continuity at every CS4 30s seam (S2, S4, S5, S8, S10). Ident plate: its 'letter shapes' must not read as real letters — the INKLIGHT logotype is the Remotion label. Global gate (brief §0.3): accent hue shift >6 frames / missing accessory / size swap = re-roll; 3rd limb or fused limb ≥3 frames = re-roll; any mouth, nose, teeth, brows, skin or human face even 1 frame = reject; flat/white/empty bg, 2D look, lost rim light or blood = re-roll; stitch seam at 30s: position jump >5% width, lighting flip, prop changing hands, screen-direction reversal = regenerate the later segment; any legible or pseudo-glyph text in a plate = mask or re-roll (all real text is Remotion labels). Check sourceSpec width/height/duration every clip.
